text:
𝗚𝗨𝗥𝗡𝗢𝗢𝗥 𝗕𝗥𝗔𝗥 𝗜𝗡? 🏏🇮🇳

Pacer Gurnoor Brar (9 wkts in 3 ODI innings v NZ) is in contention for the 2nd Test at Hagley Oval.
Gill says India might go unchanged.

Play him or not? 👇
#INDvNZ #TeamIndia

facebook.caption:
𝗚𝗨𝗥𝗡𝗢𝗢𝗥 𝗕𝗥𝗔𝗥 𝗞𝗔𝗔 𝗧𝗘𝗦𝗧 𝗗𝗘𝗕𝗨𝗧? 🏏🇮🇳

👉 Christchurch Test (27 Nov) se pehle Brar playing XI ki race mein
👉 ODI series mein 3 innings mein 9 wickets, average 15.88
👉 Gill ne kaha team unchanged bhi rah sakti hai

Brar ko khilana chahiye ya nahi? Comment karo 👇
#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
